import sys,json,csv,io,base64
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from campaign import audit
from common import parse_json
HDR=('type','id','revision','published','op','lease','event','probe','target','responder','result','service','attempt','payload')
def cap(rows):
 s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(HDR)
 for r in rows:w.writerow(r)
 return {'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(s.getvalue().encode()).decode()]}
def icmp(rid,event,probe,target,resp,result):
 return ['icmp',rid,'0','10','put','h',str(event),probe,target,resp,result,'','','']
def app(rid,event,target):
 return ['app',rid,'0','10','put','h',str(event),'','2001:db8:1:1200::'+target,'','closed','t','0','']
# Need canary target; compute from manifest formula
import hashlib,ipaddress
base=int(ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8:1:1200::/64').network_address)
net=str(ipaddress.IPv6Network((base,64)))
can=base+(int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(('x\nh\n'+net).encode()).digest()[:8],'big')|(1<<63))
canstr=str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(can))
rows=[icmp('can',1,'0/c',canstr,canstr,'echo'),

 'services':[{'id':'t','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[10],'captures':[cap(rows)],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}

print('rejected',out['rejected'])
L=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]
print(L['state'],L['conflicts'],L['internal'],L['external'],L['unresolved'],out['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'],L['services'][0])
